# Vendored: yt-dlp/ejs

`yt-dlp-ejs.js` is the JavaScript challenge solver generated by
[yt-dlp/ejs](https://github.com/yt-dlp/ejs) (bundling meriyah 6.1.4 and astring 1.9.0; licenses are
in the file's header comment). The stream observer calls it to solve the `/n/<token>/` throttling
challenge in HLS manifest URLs.

It is kept byte-for-byte as inlined in the extension, and `tests/build.test.mjs` pins its SHA-256.
The last statements inside its IIFE are Spelare glue, not upstream code: a Trusted Types policy
(`tubeless-ejs-*`) and the non-writable `window.__tubelessJSC` export.

To update: replace the file, keep or re-apply that glue, then update the hash in the test.
